summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES,  IT MAY BE POSSIBLE FOR THE FRONT BRAKE LINE TO SLIP OUT OF THE RETAINING BRACKET LOCATED AT THE FRONT STRUT.  THE BRAKE HOSE THAT IS ATTACHED TO THE BRAKE LINE COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH THE TIRE AND BE SUBJECTED TO WEAR AND ABRASION.

title: SOUND OFF, INC.: WARNING LAMPS (1,508 affected)
summary: SCHOOL BUS WARNING LAMPS MANUFACTURED PRIOR TO DECEMBER 27, 2002.  MODELS NUMBERS: AT56IEBOAREV001, E756IEBOAREV001, INT756IEBOA, TH756IEBOA, TH756IEBOA-1, AT756IEBORREV001, E756IEBOR, E758IEBORREV001, INT756EBOR, TH756IEBOR, TH756IEBOR-1.  A STATIC ELECTRICITY DISCHARGE CAN OCCUR DURING NORMAL SERVICES OR HANDLING.  THIS DISCHARGE CAN POTENTIALLY INITIATE A CHEMICAL REACTION OF MATERIALS WITHIN THE LAMP WHICH COULD CAUSE THE LENS TO FRACTURE.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: SAAB/WHEEL/TIRE CORROSION (70,726 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, IF AN OWNER CHANGES THEIR WHEELS/TIRES BETWEEN SUMMER AND WINTER USING A STEEL WHEEL IN THE WINTER AND AN ALLOY WHEEL IN THE SUMMER, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR RUST AND CONTAMINATION TO BUILD UP ON THE WHEEL HUB DURING THE STEEL WHEEL USAGE.  IF THIS OCCURS AND THE CONTAMINATION IS NOT REMOVED, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT AFTER THE TIRE CHANGE SERVICE, SOME OF THIS CONTAMINATION COULD FLAKE OR GRIND AWAY RESULTING IN REDUCED CLAMPING FORCE OF THE WHEEL TO THE HUB.  OVER SEVERAL SEASONS, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THIS REDUCED FORCE COULD RESULT IN FRACTURES DEVELOPING IN THE WHEEL BOLTS DUE TO WHEEL TO HUB MOVEMENT.

title: ALFA LEISURE,INC.: ALFA LESIURE/CATERPILLAR/ENGINE PUMPS (73 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR 3126E HYDRAULICALLY CONTROLLED ELECTRONICALLY ACTUATED UNIT INJECTED DIESEL ENGINES WITH HIGH EFFICIENCY PUMPS (HEP8).  THE PUMP COMPONENTS MAY EXPERIENCE A HIGH PRESSURE SEAL FAILURE WHICH CAN RESULT IN A SHORT PERIOD OF ROUGH RUNNING AND SUBSEQUENT ENGINE STALL DUE TO A LOSS OF INJECTION ACTUATION PRESSURE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/CATERPILLAR/ENGINE PUMPS (114 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH CATERPILLAR 3126E HYDRAULICALLY CONTROLLED ELECTRONICALLY ACTUATED UNIT INJECTED DIESEL ENGINES WITH HIGH EFFICIENCY PUMPS (HEP8).  THE PUMP COMPONENTS MAY EXPERIENCE A HIGH PRESSURE SEAL FAILURE WHICH CAN RESULT IN A SHORT PERIOD OF ROUGH RUNNING AND SUBSEQUENT ENGINE STALL DUE TO A LOSS OF INJECTION ACTUATION PRESSURE.

title: PARAMOUNT TANK, INC.: PARAMOUNT TANK/TRAILER SPRING BRAKES (15 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FULL PULL TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX SR2, SR-4, AND SR-5 TRAILER SPRING BRAKE VALVE ASSEMBLIES, THE MOLDED RUBBER FACE OF THE INLET/EXHAUST VALVE (I/E VALVE) COMPONENT OF THE AFFECTED VALVES CAN SEPARATE FROM THE VALVE METAL INSERT.  AIR CAN BE TRAPPED BY A SEPARATED I/E VALVE CAUSING IT TO BALLOON AND BLOCK THE EXHAUST PASSAGE OF THE TRAILER SPRING BRAKE CIRCUIT.

title: Jaguar Cars, Ltd.: JAGUAR/DIRECTIONAL INDICATOR (49,174 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER SEDANS, THE POWER CIRCUIT WHICH FEEDS THE DIRECTION INDICATOR SYSTEM COULD FAIL.  THIS COULD RESULT IN THE DRIVER BEING UNAWARE THAT THE EXTERNAL TURNING INDICATORS ARE NOT OPERATING BECAUSE THE INTERNAL "TELL-TAIL" LIGHT ON THE DRIVER'S INSTRUMENT PANEL CONTINUES TO WORK NORMALLY.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/FUEL TANK LEAKAGE (8,857 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MINI VANS, SOME FUEL TANKS HAVE SURFACE IMPERFECTIONS THAT COULD ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE TANK.

title: Kia America, Inc.: KIA/FMVSS 209/SEAT BELT BUCKLE ANCHOR BOLTS (21,248 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MINI VANS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."  THE SECOND AND THIRD SEAT BELT BUCKLE ANCHOR BOLTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE STANDARDS.

title: CAMPAGNA MOTO SPORT INC.: CAMPAGNA/FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR (22 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES EQUIPPED WITH PUROLATOR PRO-FUEL IN-LINE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR ARE BEING RECALLED.   THE ELASTOMETER DIAPHRAGM IN THESE REGULATORS IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH AUTOMOTIVE FUELS.  PROLONGED EXPOSURE COULD CAUSE DIAPHRAGM DEGRADATION, RESULTING IN A POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: PORSCHE/AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION CABLE ADJUSTMENT (12,234 affected)
summary: CERTAIN 2-DOOR CONVERTIBLE PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH THE TIPTRONIC (AUTOMATIC) TRANSMISSION MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH AN INCORRECTLY ADJUSTED KEY-LOCK-CABLE DOWN TO THE SHIFT SELECTOR.  IF THE KEY-LOCK-CABLE IS NOT ADJUSTED CORRECTLY, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE IGNITION KEY WILL SNAG UPON BEING REMOVED FRO THE IGNITION LOCK OR THE SLECTOR LEVER CAN BE SHIFTED FROM POSITION "P" WITH THE IGNITION KEY REMOVED AND THE LOCKING BUTTON OPERATED.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 212/WINDSHIELD BONDING (110 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PICKUP TRUCKS FAIL TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 212, "WINDSHIELD MOUNTING."  SOME OF THESE VEHICLES LACK A CONTINUOUS URETHANE BONDING BEAD BETWEEN THE BODY SURFACE AND THE WINDSHIELD.

title: Explorer Van Company, Inc.: EXPLORER VAN/RUNNING BOARD LIGHTING (2,600 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CONVERSION VANS EQUIPPED WITH RUNNING BOARDS SUPPLIED BY PRODESIGN, INC., THAT INCORPORATE A COURTESY LIGHT, EXPOSURE TO EXCESSIVE MOISTURE AND ROAD SALT, A HIGH RESISTANCE ARC CAN OCCUR IN THE WIRING OF THE COURTESY LIGHT.  WHEN THIS OCCURS, THE LIGHT WIRES CAN OVERHEAT TO THE POINT WHERE THEY MAY MELT THE RUNNING BOARD.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY-DAVIDSON/REAR BRAKE LINE ASSEMBLIES (1,762 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, THE REAR BRAKE LINE ASSEMBLIES COULD FRACTURE INTERNALLY.

title: Skyline Corporation: SKYLINE/LIFT BED SUPPORT BRACKET (126 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN "SPORTWAGON" TRAVEL AND FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS, THE SCREWS USED TO ATTACH THE LIFT BED SUPPORT BRACKET TO THE WOOD BED FRAME ARE TOO SHORT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/CROSS MEMBER FRACTURE/FUEL TANK PUNCTURE (5,734 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PICKUP TRUCKS AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, VEHICLES, DURING A 30 DEGREE LEFT ANGLE FRONTAL IMPACT OF SUFFICIENT SEVERITY, A TEAR COULD DEVELOP IN THE MID-FRAME CROSS MEMBER AT ITS ATTACHMENT TO THE LEFT FRAME RAIL.  IF THE MID-FRAME CROSS MEMBER TEARS DURING FRONTAL IMPACT AND PRODUCES A SHARP EDGE, CONTACT OF THE SHARP EDGE WITH THE FUEL TANK COULD RESULT IN A PUNCTURE OF THE FUEL TANK AND POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: Skyline Corporation: SKYLINE/GENERATOR/FUELING STATION/CHECK VALVE (453 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN "SPORTWAGON" OR "RAMPAGE" TRAVEL AND FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH THE OPTIONAL GENERATOR/FUELING STATION, THERE IS NO CHECK VALVE INSTALLED IN THE FUELING STATION WHICH COULD CAUSE GASOLINE TO SIPHON OUT.

title: UD Trucks Corporation: NISSAN DIESEL/DRIVE SHAFT (175 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS, THE DRIVE SHAFT CONNECTING THE TRANSMISSION TO THE REAR DIFFERENTIAL IS COMPRISED OF TWO OR THREE INDIVIDUAL SUB-SECTIONS BOLTED TOGETHER.  ONE END OF EACH INDIVIDUAL SUB-SECTION CONTAINS A FLANGE YOKE SUPPORTING A UNIVERSAL JOINT.  THE FLANGE YOKE ON ONE OR MORE INDIVIDUAL SUB-SECTIONS COULD DEVELOP A CRACK IN THE SHOULDER SUPPORTING THE UNIVERSAL JOINT.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: MONACO/CERTIFICATION LABEL/TIRE SIZE (6 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE FEDERAL CERTIFICATION LABEL HAS A TYPOGRAPHICAL ERROR SHOWING AN INCORRECT TIRE SIZE.  THE CORRECT TIRE SIZE SHOULD BE LISTED AS 295/80RX22.5H, WITH A PSI OF 80.

title: International Motors, LLC: INTERNATIONAL/BRAKE MODULE (146 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SCHOOL BUSES AND HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS BUILT WITH HYDRAULIC BRAKES AND AN AIR POWERED PARKING BRAKE (BRAKE CODE 04GAS)  FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE MONITOR MODULE WAS NOT INSTALLED ON CERTAIN VEHICLES.

title: ELECTRONIC MOBILITY CONTROLS: EMC/DS-2000 PRIMARY DRIVING CONTROL SYSTEM (400 affected)
summary: VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH THE EMC DS-2000 PRIMARY DRIVING CONTROL SYSTEM.  THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF VEHICLES  EQUIPPED WITH THE EMC DS-2000 DRIFTED OR VEERED OFF COURSE AND DID NOT RESPOND TO DRIVER'S STEERING EFFORTS TO CORRECT THE REPORTED DRIFTING.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: PORSCHE/FMVSS 225/TOP TETHER ANCHORAGE (48 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TWO-SEAT, TWO-DOOR COUPE MODEL PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 225, "CHILD RESTRAINT ANCHORAGE SYSTEMS."   THESE VEHICLES WERE NOT EQUIPPED WITH A TOP TETHER ANCHORAGE AS REQUIRED BY THE STANDARD.  OWNERS WHO WISH TO USE A CHILD RESTRAINT WITH THE AIR BAG DEACTIVATION DEVICE REQUIRING A TOP TETHER IN THE FRONT PASSENGER SEAT CANNOT CORRECTLY INSTALL THE SEAT DUE TO THE LACK OF THE TOP TETHER ANCHORAGE.

title: BELL AUTOMOTIVE: BELL/SAFETY HAMMERS (17,398 affected)
summary: BELL AUTOMOTIVE SAFETY HAMMERS IDENTIFIED AS "LIFE-SAVING ESCAPE AND RESCUE TOOL."  THESE HAMMERS WERE INTENDED TO BE USED AS AN INSTRUMENT TO SHATTER AUTOMOTIVE SAFETY GLASS IN THE EVENT OF AN EMERGENCY.  HOWEVER, THE PLASTIC HANDLE WAS NOT DESIGNED TO WITHSTAND THE FORCE REQUIRED TO SHATTER AUTOMOTIVE GLASS.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: MITSUBISHI/THROTTLE ICING (31,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, DURING EXTREMELY LOW TEMPERATURE CONDITIONS, ICE CAN BUILD UP INSIDE THE ENGINE THROTTLE VALVE.  THIS ICE BUILD-UP COULD CAUSE THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL TO STICK OR NOT TO RETURN TO IDLE AFTER ACCELERATING.

title: UD Trucks Corporation: NISSAN DIESEL/STEERING COUPLER SHAFT (28 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS, A STEERING COUPLER SHAFT IS UTILIZED BETWEEN THE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND THE STEERING GEAR BOX ASSEMBLY.  THIS COUPLER SHAFT HAS A FLEXIBLE YOKE WITH A PINCH BOLT CLAMP AT EACH END TO SECURE THE SHAFT TO EACH ASSEMBLY.  THE FLEXIBLE YOKE ON THE END THAT ATTACHES TO THE GEARBOX COULD DEVELOP A CRACK NEAR THE PINCH BOLT CLAMP.

title: R82, Inc.: FMVSS 213/TETHER ANCHOR WASHER CORRISION (1,146 affected)
summary: GORILLA CHILD SAFETY SEAT (MODEL NUMBER 200-1000) AND SPELCAST CHILD SAFETY SEATS (MODEL NUMBER 600-1000) MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JULY 26, 2002, AND JANUARY 15, 2003, AND OUTFITTED WITH A TETHER ANCHOR MOUNTING KIT, PART NO. FW-50250-12-ZY.  THE KIT ALLOWS THE PURCHASER TO MOUNT A TETHER ANCHOR IN A VEHICLE THAT IS NOT ALREADY EQUIPPED WITH AN ANCHOR.  THE TETHER ANCHOR KIT CONTAINS A WASHER THAT DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE SALT SPRAY STANDARD FOUND IN FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: CPSC, Pace Products Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Soap Making Kits
summary: The soap may get too hot when heated in the microwave oven and leak from the tray mold posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 145,000.

title: CPSC, Sun Rise Industrial Co., Ltd. and Raleigh America Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The frames on these bicycles can break, which can cause riders to lose control and crash. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Announce Recall of Woody Dolls
summary: The Woody doll's clothing has buttons that can detach, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 40,000.

title: CPSC, Hufco-Delaware Company and Evenflo Company Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Gerry® and Evenflo® Portable Wood Cribs
summary: If the hardware used to assemble the crib is not tight, the mattress support platform and mattress can fall to the floor. This poses a risk of injury to young children in the crib. Units: About 364,000.

title: CPSC, Magic Cabin Announce Recall of Wooden Teething Rings
summary: It is a potential choking hazard to young children. Units: 107.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The mounting bolts on the front brake calipers were not tightened to the specified torque value. This may cause the bolts to loosen or fall out during operation, resulting in brake failure. This could result in severe injury or death. Units: About 2,400.

title: CPSC, Build-A-Bear Workshop Announce Recall of "Founding Bear" Stuffed Bears
summary: The nose of the stuffed bear can be pulled or twisted off, posing a choking hazard to a young child. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, American Power Conversion Corp. Announce Recall of Back-Up Power Supply Systems
summary: The power supply device can fail, causing the unit to overheat, which may pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 900,000.

title: CPSC, Innova Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Exploding Frying Pans
summary: The pans can explode or separate when preheated, used on high heat, or used for frying, which can pose a serious burn hazard from hot oil or food contents spilling onto consumers. Units: About 8,700.

title: CPSC, Cooper Lighting Warn About 500-Watt Halogen Bulbs
summary: These 500-watt light bulbs generate very high temperatures, compared to incandescent and lower wattage halogen bulbs and can start a fire, if they come in contact with curtains, clothes or other flammable material. These bulbs are intended for use in outdoor work lights and flood lamps. To meet the

title: CPSC, Zenith Announce Recall to Repair Large-Screen, Analog Projection Televisions
summary: A tear in a gasket can cause coolant fluid to leak from the picture tube assembly. This can cause smoking, charring, and electrical arcing inside of the television, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Xerox International Partners Announce Retrofit of Network Laser Printers
summary: Arcing may cause the fuser assembly to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC Announces Recall of Baseline Design Beanbag Chairs
summary: Some of these beanbag chairs have zippers that can be opened, allowing access to the polystyrene beads inside the chairs. This poses a suffocation hazard to young children who can unzip the chair and inhale the small beads. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Tim Hortons Announce Recall of Travel Mugs
summary: The lids on some of the mugs can detach, allowing hot liquid to leak, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,500.

title: Historical tsunami: waves up to 2 m, Solomon Islands (2003-01-20)
summary: A tsunami on 2003-01-20 after an M7.3 earthquake. From NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.

title: Historical tsunami: waves up to 0.61 m, S. Mexico (2003-01-22)
summary: A tsunami on 2003-01-22 after an M7.5 earthquake. 29 deaths. From NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.
